name: clickup-tasks
title_zh: 点一下就把活儿派给对的人，状态跟着变
tagline_zh: 在 ClickUp 里建任务、指派、排优先级、挪状态，全靠 MCP 直连。不用切窗口、不用翻菜单，你开口它动手。
tagline_en: Skip the UI. Create tasks, assign people, set priorities, and update statuses in ClickUp through MCP — all from.
desc_en: Creates, assigns, prioritizes, and updates the status of ClickUp tasks via MCP. Use when the user explicitly asks to create a task, assign someone, change priority, or move a task's status.
why_zh: 它把 ClickUp 的操作变成对话，省去在界面里点来点去的功夫。指派和改状态这类高频动作。
why_en: Turns ClickUp task management into conversation. High-frequency actions like assigning and status changes happen without.
limit_zh: 只认 ClickUp 一个平台，且需要已配置 MCP 服务。它只做任务级操作，不碰项目结构、权限设置或自定义字段。
limit_en: ClickUp only, via MCP. Handles task-level ops; no project structure, permissions, or custom fields.
title_en: Create, assign, and move ClickUp tasks by just asking
